VcuDigitGlyphs.description: Three 10-entry glyph tables for the decimal digits 0..9 of the two-digit VCU display: seg_a, seg_b and seg_c. Each table is indexed by the digit value and yields one LED frame byte.

fields.name: seg_a
fields.description: Segment byte A for digit 0..9 (goes to the first frame byte of the digit).

fields.name: seg_b
fields.description: Segment byte B for digit 0..9 (low nibble of the second frame byte of the digit).

fields.name: seg_c
fields.description: Segment byte C for digit 0..9 (goes to the third frame byte of the digit).
